steps.text:
**Job Title:** Senior Network Engineer **Location:** [City, State] – Hybrid (3 days on‑site, 2 days remote) **Company Overview:** At **[Company Name]**, we operate a cutting‑edge, hyper‑scale datacenter environment that powers critical services for Fortune {{int:400:600}} customers worldwide. Our infrastructure team is focused on building resilient, high‑performance networks that support massive traffic volumes, multi‑tenant cloud platforms, and emerging AI workloads. We are seeking a senior‑level network professional to lead the design, implementation, and operation of our global network fabric. --- ### **Key Responsibilities** - **Architect & Design:** Lead the architecture of Layer 2/3, MPLS, BGP, and SD‑WAN solutions across multiple data‑center sites and cloud environments. Define standards for routing, switching, security, and automation. - **Implementation & Deployment:** Oversee end‑to‑end provisioning of high‑capacity routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. Conduct PoC, testing, and rollout of new network technologies (e.g., EVPN‑VXLAN, Segment Routing, {{int:320:480}} GbE optics). - **Operations & Troubleshooting:** Diagnose complex network incidents, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. Maintain network health dashboards and SLA reporting. - **Automation & Scripting:** Develop and maintain infrastructure‑as‑code (IaC) pipelines using Ansible, Python, Terraform, and NetBox/APIs to automate provisioning, configuration compliance, and monitoring. - **Security & Compliance:** Enforce network security best practices (ACLs, segmentation, DDoS mitigation). Ensure compliance with ISO {{int:21600:32402}}, SOC 2, and industry‑specific regulations. - **Collaboration & Mentorship:** Work closely with Cloud, Compute, Storage, and Security teams. Mentor junior engineers, conduct knowledge‑sharing sessions, and lead on‑call rotations. - **Capacity Planning & Optimization:** Analyze traffic trends, forecast growth, and recommend upgrades to meet performance and cost targets. --- ### **Required Qualifications** | Requirement | Details | |-------------|---------| | **Experience** | 7+ years designing, deploying, and operating enterprise‑grade networks; 3+ years in a senior/lead role. | | **Technical Skills** | • Advanced knowledge of BGP, OSPF, IS‑IS, MPLS, EVPN, VXLAN.
• Hands‑on with Cisco Nexus/ASR, Arista, Juniper, and/or Nokia platforms.
• Proficient in routing protocols, QoS, multicast, and high‑availability designs.
• Strong scripting abilities (Python, Bash) and automation frameworks (Ansible, Terraform). | | **Certifications** | CCNP/CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent highly preferred. | | **Cloud & Virtualization** | Experience integrating on‑prem networking with AWS, Azure, GCP, or OpenStack (Hybrid Cloud). | | **Monitoring & Ops** | Familiarity with NetFlow/IPFIX, SNMP, Prometheus, Grafana, and ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira). | | **Problem‑Solving** | Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, multi‑layer network failures under pressure. | | **Communication** | Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences. | | **Education** | Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). | --- ### **Preferred Extras** - Experience with data‑center fabrics (e.g., Cisco ACI, VMware NSX, Calico). - Knowledge of SD‑WAN solutions (Viptela, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto Prisma). - Familiarity with network telemetry (gNMI, streaming telemetry) and AI‑driven analytics. - Participation in open‑source networking projects or community forums. --- ### **What We Offer** - Competitive base salary + performance bonuses. - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans. - {{int:320:482}}(k) match and generous PTO. - Professional development budget & certification reimbursements. - Modern tech stack with opportunities to work on next‑generation networking challenges. - Collaborative, inclusive culture that values innovation and continuous learning. --- **Apply Now:** Submit your résumé, a brief cover letter highlighting your most impactful network project, and any relevant certifications to **careers@[companydomain].com** with the subject line **“Senior Network Engineer – [Your Name]”.** *We are an equal‑opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*
